subject: Sterile site rolling update authorization and signer cadence
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Alice Mason <alice.mason@terrahealth.com>, ops@terrahealth.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-31T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sterile site rolling update authorization and signer cadence

Hi Alice / TerraHealth ops team,

Following our on-site prep call, we are sharing the proposed cadence for signed bundle promotion and an authorization flow for the rolling update window at your sterile site (islanded network). Goal: minimize operator intervention while keeping a clear signer quorum and emergency rollback path.

Summary (high level):
- Promotion cadence: signed bundle -> validation window -> operator activation (staged per rack)
- Signer quorum: 3-of-4 (TerraHealth lead ops, on-site custodian, Redwood on-call, third-party auditor)
- Rollback: immediate deactivation + signed revert bundle; operator must confirm checksum and signer set before reactivation

Attached: sterile_bundle_v1.tar.gz + sha256, signer_roster_v2.csv. Please confirm if the quorum needs adjustment for your internal compliance policy.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) TerraHealth to ack quorum and list who will act as on-site custodian.
2) Redwood to run a rehearsal of the activation steps in a staging network (we can record the run).
3) Agree on a 2-hour activation window on Nov 5 where we will promote rack groups A/B.

If this looks good, I’ll send the formal sign-off checklist for signatures (DocuSign link included).

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Sr. Security Program Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Alice Mason <alice.mason@terrahealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, ops@terrahealth.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-31T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sterile site rolling update authorization and signer cadence

Thanks, Irene — received and reviewed the plan. A few clarifications from TerraHealth side: 

- We can meet the 3-of-4 signer quorum but request the 3rd signer be an internal compliance officer rather than an external auditor for this rollout. (We will still capture an auditor snapshot after completion.)
- On-site custodian for Nov 5: Jenna Park (onsite lead) — cc’d ops alias will provide a phone and PGP thumbprint during the activation window.
- For the rollback, we require a mandatory 15-minute hold to confirm logs and health checks before we demote a new bundle. Can you include that in the activation script?

We will confirm formal signers by EOD Nov 2. Rehearsal in staging is welcome; please propose 1-hour slots next week.

Best,
Alice
Alice Mason
Head of Infrastructure Ops — TerraHealth
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Mason <alice.mason@terrahealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, ops@terrahealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sterile site rolling update authorization and signer cadence

Alice — thanks for the quick feedback. Short notes and adjustments we’ll adopt: 

1) Signer quorum: switch to TerraHealth compliance officer as the 3rd signer (acknowledged). We’ll include an optional external auditor signature post-activation for audit trails.

2) 15-minute mandatory hold before demotion: will add a pre-demotion checkpoint that verifies:
   - KV cache flush status
   - Healthcheck pass for primary proxies (x3 consecutive probes)
   - Log snapshot uploaded to the transfer envelope (we’ll store in the drive folder and push checksum to the signer roster)

3) Activation script (high level) included below — please note these are the operator steps that will be included in the rehearsal doc: 
   a) Verify signer roster and checksum on operator console (step shows expected sha256)
   b) Stage bundle on isolated jump host (tar verification + signature chain verify)
   c) Promote rack group A (30% of nodes) and run smoke tests (5m)
   d) Wait 10 minutes, run health probes; if green, promote rack group B (remaining)
   e) If any probe fails, initiate rollback flow (immediate demote + signed revert bundle applied)

4) We will also include an operator-confirmation webhook that requires a TRUSTED operator token — this addresses the requirement for a human-in-loop gate during the 15-minute hold.

Irene — I’ll prepare a rehearsal slot proposal and a condensed operator checklist for Nov 2. Ben / Marissa — can you confirm availability to attend the rehearsal and own the on-call pager during the activation?

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Alice Mason <alice.mason@terrahealth.com>, ops@terrahealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sterile site rolling update authorization and signer cadence

Quick ack — I’m available for the Nov 5 activation window and will cover the on-call pager during rehearsal window (Nov 3 or 4). A couple of pragmatic notes from ops: 

- Please ensure the operator checklist includes the exact PGP thumbprint string we expect from the on-site custodian; we had a near-miss in a previous exercise where a thumbprint formatting mismatch caused delays.
- For offline bundles: we recommend naming the revert bundle with a clear timestamp and sequence id (e.g., revert_20261105_01.tar.gz) so we can avoid mismatch during emergency demote.

Irene / Karthik — I’ll attach a short runbook excerpt and a sanitized log example to the DocuSign envelope before we finalize signers.

Ben Carter
Manager, Field Deployments — Redwood Inference
(attachment: runbook_excerpt.txt, sanitized_log_sample.txt)
